lessons.title: Present Perfect: life experiences
objectives: Ask about an experience without naming a finished past time.
Use have/has with common past participles.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Perfect ka pattern have/has + past participle hai. Is lesson mein zindagi ke tajurbay poochte hain jab exact guzra waqt nahin bataya jata. Have you ever travelled by train? ka matlab ab tak kabhi train se safar kiya hai? I have visited Lahore tajurba batata hai. Yesterday ya last year jaisa finished waqt dena ho to Past Simple chahiye: I visited Lahore last year.
rulesRomanUrdu: I/you/we/they have; he/she/it has + past participle.
Visit → visited, see → seen, eat → eaten, go → gone; been bhi be ka participle hai.
Ever sawal mein kabhi; never tajurbay ki nafi: I have never flown.
Question: Have you ever visited...? Short answer: Yes, I have.

Woh Ali se hotel mein kabhi thehrnay ka poochti hai. Ali haan kehta hai magar tareekh nahin deta. Dono tajurbon ki baat kar rahe hain.

lessons.title: Present Perfect with just, already and yet
objectives: Describe a recent result with just or already.
Use yet in simple questions and negatives.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Perfect se haal se juda recent result bhi batate hain. Just ka matlab abhi abhi, already ka matlab pehle hi, aur yet ka matlab sawal mein ab tak aur negative mein abhi tak nahin ho sakta hai. Just aur already aam tor par have/has aur participle ke darmiyan aate hain. Yet aam tor par sawal ya negative ke aakhir mein hota hai. I have just finished ka nateeja yeh hai ke kaam ab mukammal hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: Have/has + just + participle: She has just arrived.
Have/has + already + participle: I have already paid.
Question: Have you finished yet?
Negative: I have not finished yet. Yet yahan aakhir mein hai.

lessons.title: Present Perfect with for and since
objectives: Describe a state that started before now and continues.
Choose for for duration and since for a starting point.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Perfect continuing state ko bhi bata sakta hai: I have lived here for two years ka matlab main do saal se yahan rehta ya rehti hoon aur ab bhi yahin hoon. For muddat batata hai, jaise for three months. Since shuru ka waqt batata hai, jaise since May. Have/has + lived/known/had jaise participles istemal karain. Is lesson mein Present Perfect Continuous ki alag form nahin sikhayi ja rahi.
rulesRomanUrdu: For + duration: for two years, for three months.
Since + starting point: since May, since 2020.
I have lived here for two years; state ab tak chal rahi hai.
Question: How long have you lived here?

lessons.title: Present Perfect compared with Past Simple
objectives: Separate an undated experience from a dated finished event.
Ask a Past Simple follow-up after an experience question.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Perfect exact finished waqt diye baghair experience ya haal se juda result batata hai. Past Simple finished event ke saath yesterday, last week ya in 2020 jaisa guzra waqt de sakta hai. Have you ever visited Lahore? ke baad When did you go? pooch sakte hain. I went last year usi experience ki dated detail hai. I have visited Lahore yesterday is lesson ke standard pattern mein durust nahin.
rulesRomanUrdu: Experience: Have you ever visited Lahore?
Dated event: I visited Lahore last year.
Follow-up: When did you go? Past helper did ke baad go base form hai.
Finished past-time expressions ko Present Perfect ke saath na milayain.

lessons.title: Past Continuous: an action in progress
objectives: Use was/were + -ing for an action in progress at a past time.
Make a question and negative in Past Continuous.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Past Continuous guzray hue waqt ke kisi lamhay mein chalne wala kaam batata hai. At eight last night, I was cooking ka matlab us waqt khana pakana chal raha tha. I/he/she/it ke saath was aur you/we/they ke saath were, phir verb-ing aata hai. Negative mein not lagta hai; sawal mein was/were subject se pehle aa jata hai. Is tense se har dafa kaam ka shuru ya khatam hona nahin pata chalta.
rulesRomanUrdu: Was/were + verb-ing: She was reading. They were waiting.
Past reference dein: at eight last night.
Negative: We were not sleeping.
Question: What were you doing? / Was she working?

lessons.title: Background actions with when and while
objectives: Link an ongoing background action with a shorter past event.
Use while for two actions happening at the same time.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Past Continuous background ka chalne wala kaam aur Past Simple aik mukammal event dikha sakta hai. I was cooking when the phone rang mein cooking chal rahi thi aur phone ring hua. While I was cooking, Ali was setting the table mein dono kaam us waqt saath chal rahe thay. When aur while ki har mumkin use ko aik rule mein band nahin karte; is lesson mein in do clear patterns ki practice hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: Background: was/were + ing; shorter event: Past Simple.
I was reading when the phone rang.
While + ongoing action: While I was cooking, Ali was setting the table.
If the while clause comes first, separate it from the main clause with a comma in writing.

lessons.title: Future arrangements, intentions and timetables
objectives: Use Present Continuous for a future arrangement with a clear time.
Distinguish a personal intention from a fixed timetable.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Future ke liye sirf will nahin hota. Present Continuous confirmed personal arrangement dikha sakta hai: I am meeting Ali tomorrow. Going to pehle se irada batata hai. Fixed timetable ke liye Present Simple aam hai: The train leaves at ten. Maani aur context dekhein; kuch plans ko aik se zyada natural forms mein kehna mumkin hai. Is lesson mein har example ka context saaf diya gaya hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: Confirmed arrangement: I am meeting Ali at six tomorrow.
Intention: I am going to learn to cook.
Fixed timetable: The train leaves at ten.
Future time expression dein taa ke am meeting ko abhi ka kaam na samjha jaye.

lessons.title: Future predictions and possibilities
objectives: Use will/will not for a simple prediction.
Use may or might to show that a future event is possible.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Will + base verb se future ke baare mein prediction de sakte hain. May aur might + base verb possibility batate hain, yani event ho sakta hai magar yaqini daawa nahin. It may rain aur it might rain dono possibility hain; in ke liye is lesson mein fixed percentage nahin diya jata. I will help you offer ya wada bhi ho sakta hai, is liye sirf form nahin context samajhain.
rulesRomanUrdu: Will/will not + base verb: It will be busy.
May/might + base verb: The bus might arrive late.
Negative possibility: It may not be open.
Modal ke baad to ya third-person s nahin: she might come.

lessons.title: Can and could: ability and requests
objectives: Describe present ability with can and general past ability with could.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Can + base verb present ability batata hai: I can swim. Could general past ability bhi bata sakta hai: I could swim when I was five. Is lesson mein aik khaas past occasion par kamyabi ki alag forms nahin sikhayi ja rahi.
rulesRomanUrdu: Ability now: can/cannot + base verb.
General ability in the past: could/could not + base verb.
Request: Can you...? / Could you...please?
No do/does with modal questions: Can she swim?

Negative: should not = shouldn't.

lessons.title: Must, have to and not having to
objectives: Express a basic obligation with must or have to.
Distinguish prohibition from absence of necessity.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Must aur have to dono context ke mutabiq zaroorat ya obligation bata sakte hain. Must ke baad base verb aur he/she ke saath has to aata hai. Must not ka matlab mana hai. Do not have to ka matlab zaroori nahin, yani choice hai. In dono negatives ka maani aik nahin. Is lesson ke rules aik imaginary club ke hain, kisi asal idaray ya qanoon ki hidayat nahin.
rulesRomanUrdu: Must + base verb: You must bring your pass.
Have to / has to + base verb: She has to arrive at nine.
Must not = mana hai; isay permission na samjhein.
Do not have to = lazmi nahin; karna phir bhi mumkin hai.

objectives: Write a polite message about a changed plan.

rulesRomanUrdu: I’m sorry, I can’t meet at ... se tabdeeli narmi se batayen.
Could we meet at ... instead? se nayi tajweez den.
Please let me know if that works for you se tasdeeq mang sakte hain.
Din, waqt aur jagah ko wazeh rakhen; instead purani choice ki jagah nayi choice batata hai.

lessons.title: Paragraph writing: a connected short account
objectives: Write a short paragraph with a main idea and supporting details.
Review your own writing using a checklist and example.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Paragraph aik markazi baat par jure hue jumlon ka chhota group hai. Topic sentence se baat shuru karen, phir do ya teen details aur aakhir mein munasib closing den. Is practice mein apni writing khud checklist se dekhen; app grammar ya quality ka score nahin deti.
rulesRomanUrdu: Aik topic chunen: masalan class ka aik din ya farzi outing.
Topic sentence ke baad relevant details likhen; har jumle mein naya ghair-mutaliq topic na layen.
Then, because, but aur so jaisay connectors zaroorat ke mutabiq istemal karen.
Capital letter, full stop aur tense consistency dobara dekhen. Model paragraph sirf aik mumkin jawab hai.

rulesRomanUrdu: I’m sorry, there is a problem with ... se masla batayen.
Could we ... instead? se badal tajweez karen.
If ... , we will ... se mumkin halat aur nateeja batayen.
So, we will meet at ... se aakhri waqt aur jagah confirm karen.
